title: 011 报信012 王姬疑云
content_zh:
沈知气得咬牙切齿。
“殿下金尊玉贵，何苦自欺而戏我？”
他已经无从判断眼前这位究竟是真的失忆还是假的失忆，本以为她只是独夫民贼，奢靡残暴，不曾想她还有戏耍人的爱好。沈知懊悔自己此前为何要折返回去毁尸灭迹。
他也不算欺骗张泱。
沈知确实是在找他大哥。
只是在找大哥的路上偶遇两名伪装难民的王姬随侍，并且从这些随侍口中知晓王姬惨死破屋之事。沈知不知道他大哥在这件事情扮演什么角色，是一个完全不知情的人，一个知情但睁一只眼闭一只眼的人，还是参与者？
王姬的尸体一定不能被发现。
沈知咬咬牙，打听到大致方向便杀人灭口，赶来给王姬收尸，打算毁尸灭迹。不管大哥扮演什么角色，杀人证据都要处理干净，拖一拖时间，最好拖到旧朝灭，新朝立。
新朝建立，谁还管旧朝王姬死谁手里？
终于，他在那个不同寻常的雷雨夜找到了凶杀现场，看到了一堆碎尸块死而复生。
张泱道：“你为什么要生气？”
她给沈知一个给她发布任务的机会，她会帮对方跑腿干活，不计较报酬，如此美事为何还愤怒？真是得寸进尺的PC！张泱盯着沈知脖子，想着杀他再刷新的可行性。
啧，还是人类玩家比较方便。
根本不用忍受沈知的阴阳反复。
对于张泱带着委屈的反问，沈知气得手指都发抖，萌生杀人的冲动，只是他的理智让他打消念头。自从这位殿下在生死走一遭，获得砍头砍脚砍手都不死的惊人天赋，又多了一身不知何时偷偷学的武力，哪里是自己一两剑就能杀的？回头谁灭谁还不知呢。
沈知强迫自己忍下情绪。
他岔开话题：“殿下有所不知，那些反贼时有杀良冒功。今日让这么多俘虏跑了，叛军为了对上有个交代，怕是会用另一批人充数。我也是想到这点，这才忧心忡忡。”
“哦，就是说横竖有一批人是要死的？”
张泱感慨剧情的强大。
难怪那些观察样本喜欢问候游戏策划——认认真真做剧情任务的玩家看似有的选，实则没得选。这种不管干涉不干涉都造孽的剧情，真是给他们写爽了，被问候是该的。

“能这么说。”
沈知觉得她这话哪里不对。
然后，张泱下一句：“那还管什么？”
沈知不可置信：“你这还是人话？”
张泱：“那确实不算人话了。”
哼，她这是PC的话。
沈知气得胸口剧烈起伏：“……疯言疯语，你疯了，我也是疯了，居然还觉得可能是大哥判断偏颇，或是民间对你有什么误解，或是你自己有苦衷不得不藏拙自污……”
张泱饶有兴致欣赏沈知三尸神暴跳模样，完全无法理解沈知的愤怒源于何处，也不理解他为何能气成这个样子，一张脸蛋又红又青又白的，额头还因此往外冒着汗珠子。
她从游戏背包掏出一把扇子。
“来，扇扇风，别把CPU烧坏了。”
观察样本有说过，人生气太狠会脑溢血。
沈知的怒火进一步升级，就在他要撕破脸皮的时候，张泱一脸认真宽慰他：“我懂了懂了，你是在气愤那些叛军？确实，虽说菜是原罪，你的能力上限在这里，上去也是给他们送人头，可抓俘虏的是他们，杀良冒功也是他们，没必要因为他们气死自己。”
她对家园支线了解太少了。
也不知道这种PC死了多久刷新。
沈知：“……”
尽管张泱这话是在火上浇油，不过她有一点还是说对了的，一切都是叛军在造孽。
content_en:
Shen Zhi was so angry that he gritted his teeth.
"Your Highness is so noble and noble, why do you deceive yourself and make fun of me?"
He could no longer tell whether the person in front of him had real amnesia or fake amnesia. He originally thought that she was just a loner, extravagant and cruel, but he never thought that she also had a hobby of playing tricks on people. Shen Zhi regretted why he had to go back and destroy the corpse.
It's not like he cheated Zhang Yang.
Shen Zhi is indeed looking for his elder brother.
On the way to find his eldest brother, he met two of Wang Ji's attendants pretending to be refugees, and learned from these attendants about Wang Ji's tragic death and the destruction of the house. Does Shen Zhi know what role his elder brother played in this matter? Is he a completely unaware person, a person who knew but turned a blind eye, or a participant?
Wang Ji’s body must not be found.
Shen Zhi gritted his teeth and after finding out the general direction, he killed and silenced her. He rushed to collect Wang Ji's body and planned to destroy it and eliminate any traces. No matter what role the eldest brother plays, the evidence of the murder must be dealt with. It is best to delay it until the old dynasty is destroyed and a new dynasty is established.
When a new dynasty is established, who cares who will kill the queen of the old dynasty?
Finally, he found the murder scene on that unusual thunderstorm night and saw a pile of broken corpses resurrected from the dead.
Zhang Yang said: "Why are you angry?"
She gave Shen Zhi a chance to assign tasks to her. She would run errands for him, regardless of reward. Why would she be angry about such a beautiful thing? What a PC that goes beyond the limits! Zhang Yang stared at Shen Zhi's neck, thinking about the feasibility of killing him and refreshing it.
Gee, it’s more convenient for human players.
There is no need to endure Shen Zhi's repeated yin and yang.
In response to Zhang Yang's aggrieved question, Shen Zhi was so angry that his fingers trembled and he had the urge to kill, but his reason made him give up the idea. Ever since His Highness experienced life and death and gained the astonishing talent of being able to cut off heads, feet, hands, and hands without dying, and also acquired a martial arts secretly learned at some point, how could he be able to kill with just one or two swords? We still don’t know who will be destroyed later.
Shen Zhi forced himself to endure his emotions.
He changed the topic: "Your Highness, you don't know. Those rebels sometimes kill good people and take credit for their crimes. Today, so many prisoners were allowed to escape. In order to have an explanation to the rebels, they are afraid that they will use another group of people to make up the number. I also thought of this, so I became worried."
"Oh, you mean a group of people are going to die anyway?"
Zhang Yang lamented the power of the plot.
No wonder those observation samples like to greet game planners - players who conscientiously complete plot tasks seem to have a choice, but in fact they have no choice. This kind of plot, in which people commit evil regardless of whether they interfere or not, was really fun to write for them, and they deserved to be greeted.
"You can say that."
Shen Zhi felt that there was something wrong with what she said.
Then, Zhang Yang said next: "Then why do you care?"
Shen Zhi couldn't believe it: "Are you talking humanly?"
Zhang Yang: "That's really not human talk."
Humph, she was talking about PC.
Shen Zhi was so angry that his chest heaved violently: "...you are talking crazy, you are crazy, and I am also crazy. You actually think that my elder brother may be biased in his judgment, or that the public has some misunderstanding about you, or that you have your own difficulties and have to hide your shame..."
Zhang Yang was very interested in admiring the violent appearance of Shen Zhi's three corpse gods. He couldn't understand where Shen Zhi's anger came from, nor why he was so angry. His face was red, blue and white, and beads of sweat appeared on his forehead.
She took out a fan from her gaming backpack.
"Come on, fan yourself, don't burn out the CPU."
Observation samples have said that people who are too angry will have cerebral hemorrhage.
Shen Zhi's anger escalated further, and just when he was about to break up, Zhang Yang comforted him with a serious look on his face: "I understand, are you angry at those rebels? Indeed, although dishonesty is the original sin, the limit of your ability is here. You went up to kill them, but they were the ones who captured the prisoners, and they were also the ones who killed good people and took credit. There is no need to be angry with yourself because of them."
She knew too little about the Home plot.
norKnow how long it takes for this kind of PC to be dead to refresh.
Shen Zhi: "..."
Although Zhang Yang's words were adding fuel to the fire, she was right about one thing. The rebels were responsible for everything.
